  "task": "Manage projects, team communication, and files in a centralized workspace",
  "benefits": [
    "Organizes tasks, communication, files, and updates in one workspace",
    "Provides a straightforward and easy-to-learn interface",
    "Facilitates file sharing and team collaboration for accessible project information",
    "Offers a good balance of features without over-complicating project management"
  ],
  "frictions": [
    "Some features feel limited compared to more advanced tools",
    "Reporting and customization options could be more extensive",
    "Occasional bugs or issues can make certain workflows less smooth",
    "Invoicing and payment capabilities are less comprehensive than dedicated tools"
  ]
}
